title: Orange YOLO spatial mask runtime policy (version 1)
description: The policy one camera's YOLO worker applies to detections: the dish centroid gate and the optional neural-input mask, in camera-native pixels, with the registration artifact it came from. Written by orange::analytics_mask::policy_to_json (src/yolo_spatial_mask.h). It appears embedded, never as a file of its own: in Cam<serial>_yolo_events.jsonl (session_header and spatial_mask_policy lines, spatial_mask, with policy_generation), and in recording_geometry_contract.json (analytics_runtime.yolo_spatial_mask.cameras.<serial> and cameras.<serial>.yolo_spatial_mask_runtime, with status and, once armed, policy_generation). mode off is the default and what recordings have used since 2026-08-25 (the rig has no accepted registration now): the ids, paths and digest are then empty strings and both circles are zero. Four GUI recordings on 2026-08-25 ran gate_only and gate_and_input_mask. An active mode (audit, gate_only, gate_and_input_mask) needs a schema-v2 dish top-rim observation and a recording-local copy identified by a sha256: token. Closed.

mode.description: off: nothing evaluated. audit: the centroid gate is evaluated and outside detections are logged as would_reject, nothing is removed. gate_only: outside detections are removed. gate_and_input_mask: removed, and the network input outside the input circle is set to outside_tensor_value.

registration_id.description: The physical or daily registration the circles come from.

source_raster.description: The camera-native raster the circles are expressed in (0 x 0 when mode is off).

outside_tensor_value.description: Normalised network-input value written outside the input circle.

input_context_outset_px.description: How far the input circle extends beyond the centroid-gate circle, in pixels.

evaluated.description: True in every mode but off.

enforced.description: True in gate_only and gate_and_input_mask: outside detections are removed before tracking and IPC.

source.description: The registration artifact (a dish top-rim observation) the circles were resolved from.

path.description: Where Orange read the artifact on the host.

recording_relative_path.description: The copy sealed with the recording, relative to the recording root.

sha256.description: sha256: token of the recording-local copy (agent-contracts digest_form_v1); empty when mode is off.

policy_generation.description: Added where the policy is embedded: the worker's policy generation (event logs; geometry contract once armed). Frame lines name the generation whose policy applied.

status.description: Added in the geometry contract: resolved (GUI, before the worker took it), armed (GUI, worker applied it), requested_before_worker_start (headless).

allOf.description: An active mode is identified by its registration and a schema-v2 top-rim observation copied into the recording.
gate_only removes outside detections; the input is not masked.
gate_and_input_mask removes outside detections and masks the network input.
